items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I was on the show with him for about 31 weeks and he robbed them 31 weeks.

ctx.x: So as long as Will Rogers was alive, he was in there. And all of America just loved it, just ate it up. Ate it up. Lackadaisical; so lazy. (Inaudible). And he was another one that was slick. He always had his -- name was Lincoln Perry, I think. All had beautiful cars, beautiful women. When they get famous, doing what he was doing, you'd better not be trying to talk him out of that stuff, man. You dare not.

And you know, on the shows, all these people loved to gamble. Stepen Fetchit used to have a dressing room, have all kinds of biscuits for the boys, and they would come there to get him. And he would rob them every week. I was on the show with him for about 31 weeks and he robbed them 31 weeks. And I said, "Stepen" he said, "What, do you say, Jack. If they want it, And so I give them the pleasure of trying. (Inaudible)."

I think Stepen Fetchit has a lot to do with Mohammed's fighting. Because I can see things in what Stepen Fetchit's (logically) and everything, because that have a lot to do with Elijah and all that. Did you know that?
